description:
There is no PATCH on /api/exercises, so a typo in an exercise name is permanent the moment any set references it. Add a rename that changes the name only.

Explicitly not kind: RULES 4 forbids editing the discriminant that decides how set_log columns are read until the snapshot column exists. Must respect the (userId, name) unique index, and leave intact the archived-name resurrection path in POST /api/exercises, which depends on that same index.
title: Rename an exercise without losing history
